case.title: BW MAPLE and DAWN KANCHIPURAM collision off Kamarajar Port
case.subRegion: 2 nm off Kamarajar Port, Ennore, north of Chennai

incident.positionSource: APPROXIMATE: 'two nautical miles off Kamarajar Port'

oil.spilledNote: ~196 t Grade 6 bunker fuel (IEEE study); about 160 t sludge recovered by 7 Feb 2017. Wikipedia volume figure is inconsistent and not used.

observations.description: About 34,000 sq m of sea affected near collision site
Oil on rocky shores ~13 km south of port; RK Nagar Kuppam worst affected

timeline.event: Outbound BW Maple collides with inbound Dawn Kanchipuram
Oil patches ashore ~13 km south of port
Clean-up largely complete; ~160 t sludge recovered by 5,700+ people

case.officialFindings: Collision; bunker fuel released from ruptured tank of Dawn Kanchipuram. DG Shipping inquiry; charges filed.

sources.title: Assessment of Ennore Oil Spill 2017 (IEEE Xplore)
Collision between BW Maple and Dawn Kanchipuram (VesselFinder)

assumptions: Shape assumed circular; only area was reported
